research_question: Does a prior-only beta-adjusted 24-hour residual trend identify focal-market price discovery that continues after a separately completed fifteen-minute confirmation and twenty basis points of costs?

sources: dynamic crypto lead-lag and price-discovery studies
V26 residual OI position-buildup continuation evidence
reused: remove the current common crypto factor with prior-only rolling beta
trade only the unique residual leader rather than the market-wide beta move
require high notional participation, aligned taker pressure and a later confirmation

scenario.context: completed thirty-minute returns for all four markets and a prior-only seven-day beta to the median of the three peer returns
scenario.state: the focal market is the unique largest absolute z-score of its rolling twenty-four-hour beta residual, at least one and a half standard deviations from its prior distribution
scenario.interaction: the current thirty-minute residual return, body, quote volume and taker pressure all align with the twenty-four-hour residual direction
scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar extends in the residual direction with a directional body and aligned taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: outside the current thirty-minute event extreme plus ten percent of prior thirty-minute ATR
scenario.management: trail the best completed thirty-minute close by one and a half prior ATRs
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose the largest fixed residual-quality score

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: beta, residual distribution and volume threshold use rows strictly before the event; event state is completed before a separate confirmation

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only the unchanged residual-discovery route passing every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune beta, residual horizon, z-score, confirmation or stop thresholds after evaluation.
